# LX Obsidian Labs

> South African AI and software engineering company. We build intelligent platforms, automation systems and digital infrastructure — web platforms, mobile apps, AI automation, business systems and cloud infrastructure — and ship our own products.

Founded in South Africa in 2016, LX Obsidian Labs designs and engineers custom software from concept through deployment, and operates a small portfolio of real, available products. Free discovery call; pricing from R4,500 for a basic website launch.

## Products

- [AI Platform](/ai): Generate, debug and preview web apps in the browser using free NVIDIA and OpenRouter models.
- [LX AI Builder](/build): Generate, refine, explain and preview real web apps live in your browser with the real AI engine.
- [Synapse AI](/synapse): AI-powered browser automation extension for Chrome, Edge and Brave.
- [Vista Cinema](/vista): Free movie and TV streaming companion app for Android.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Verified catalogue of LX products with active destinations — no placeholder listings.

## Services

- [Services](/services): AI & automation, web platforms, mobile applications, business systems, cloud & infrastructure, UI/UX & product design.
- [Integrations](/integrations): Log sources and integration options across JS/Node, Python, PHP, .NET, cloud platforms and more.
- [Mobile Apps](/mobile-apps): PWA and Android mobile apps for businesses.
- [Local Visibility](/local-visibility): Local search and Google Business Profile optimisation support.
